name: Ornith 1.5 35B-A3B Q4_K_M on one Intel Arc Pro B70

library.summary: 35B-class Qwen-derived MoE (256 experts / 8 active, arch qwen35moe) reaching 118.0 tok/s on a single card with the lab's validated expert-reduction, recurrent, state-materialization, alpha-gate, routed gate/up, and shared-residual/RMSNorm patches.

featured_metric.label: decode (3B active parameters)
featured_metric.scope: Mean of two fresh-server suite medians (118.592 and 117.505 tok/s), up-to-512-token responses, target-only, cache-zero; +1.41% incremental from the MoE shared-branch residual/RMSNorm fusion.

contributors.name: neural.download lab
contributors.contribution: Intake verification, bring-up, baselines, depth sweep, ordered MoE add-reduction, recurrent convolution-SiLU, residual-RMSNorm, recurrent concat/state, direct gather/state, recurrent alpha-gate, routed-expert gate/up, and MoE shared-branch residual/RMSNorm patches, operating point, canary battery, and package.
contributors.validated_effect: +4.85% matched fresh-server decode from ordered expert reduction, +2.10% incremental from recurrent convolution-SiLU, +1.37% incremental from residual-RMSNorm, +2.74% incremental from recurrent concat/state, +1.12% incremental from direct recurrent gather, +2.04% incremental from recurrent alpha-gate, +2.33% incremental from routed gate/up fusion, then +1.41% incremental from the MoE shared-branch residual/RMSNorm fusion (116.406 to 118.048 tok/s in the final-library matched suite).

known_limitations: MoE rate reflects ~3B active parameters; not comparable to dense 35B expectations.
Canary battery is objective self-consistency only; no cross-model oracle.
Stock two-card layer split measured 102.01/102.20 tok/s versus 104.84/104.81 on one card (-2.6%): use one card for single-stream decode.
Fresh stock servers matched 0/12 complete realistic-suite hashes across processes on this runtime; same-binary door-off/on 400-token output and within-server 8x stability passed.

Stage the GGUF on local or sufficiently fast direct-attached storage; optimized first-token setup rereads roughly 20.0 GB of expert tensors, making a 100 Mb/s NFS mmap unsuitable for cold benchmarking.

runtime.build: cmake -G Ninja -B build-sycl-aot-bmg-g31 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=icpx -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=icx -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON -DGGML_NATIVE=ON -DGGML_SYCL=ON -DGGML_SYCL_F16=ON -DGGML_SYCL_GRAPH=ON -DGGML_SYCL_DNN=ON -DGGML_SYCL_HOST_MEM_FALLBACK=ON -DGGML_SYCL_DEVICE_ARCH=bmg_g31 -DGGML_SYCL_MAX_PARALLEL_LINK_JOBS=8 -DLLAMA_CURL=OFF && cmake --build build-sycl-aot-bmg-g31 --target llama-server llama-bench -j2

project_patches.reason: The validated one-card serving stack depends on the lab's strict ordered eight-expert FP32 reduction, Ornith-shape recurrent convolution-SiLU fusion, graph-visible residual-RMSNorm fusion, Qwen-derived recurrent concat/state fusion, direct gathered-state materialization, recurrent alpha-gate fusion, tuned routed-expert gate/up/SWIGLU fusion, and MoE shared-branch residual/RMSNorm extension.

commands.preflight: python3 scripts/verify-neural-download-model.py repro/ornith-15-35b-a3b-q4km-b70/model-manifest.json "$MODEL_DIR" && echo '9022e13f8372b03c0ae47fc07229f0a3e1b7e5da8dcb3d54cd4050e7db852624  patches/ornith-15-35b-a3b-q4km-b70/llama-cpp-ornith15-moe-add-conv-silu-residual-rms-concat-state-direct-alpha-moe-gate-up-shared-residual-rms-20260823.patch' | sha256sum -c - && source /opt/intel/oneapi/setvars.sh --force && export ONEAPI_DEVICE_SELECTOR=level_zero:0
commands.launch: GGML_SYCL_ENABLE_GRAPH=0 GGML_SYCL_FUSED_MOE_ADD_REDUCE=1 GGML_SYCL_FUSED_ORNITH_CONV_SILU=1 GGML_SYCL_FUSED_RESIDUAL_RMS_NORM=1 GGML_SYCL_FUSED_ORNITH_CONCAT_STATE=1 GGML_SYCL_FUSED_ORNITH_CONCAT_STATE_DIRECT=1 GGML_SYCL_FUSED_ORNITH_ALPHA_GATE=1 GGML_SYCL_FUSED_ORNITH_MOE_GATE_UP=1 GGML_SYCL_FUSED_ORNITH_MOE_SHARED_RESIDUAL_RMS=1 BUILD_DIR/bin/llama-server --model $MODEL_DIR/Ornith-1.5-35B-Q4_K_M.gguf --alias ornith35b --reasoning off --ctx-size 8192 --cache-type-k f16 --cache-type-v f16 --device SYCL0 --gpu-layers 99 --flash-attn auto --parallel 1 --cache-ram 0 --ctx-checkpoints 0 --fit off --metrics --no-webui --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18100
commands.benchmark: python3 scripts/bench-openai-realistic-suite.py --base-url http://127.0.0.1:18100 --model ornith35b --api-mode completions --suite repro/qwen36-27b-autoround-int4-b70/realistic-suite-v1.json --max-tokens 512 --metric-tokens 100 --seed 1 --request-extra-json '{"cache_prompt":false,"seed":42,"temperature":0}' --out bench.json
